The amount is written '571.' followed by a dash/squiggle standing in for the cents in every instance (row, schedule TOTAL and both cover cells): read 571.00 per the trailing-dash convention, with the verbatim glyph noted on the row.

gates.balance_chain: CROSS-REPORT CHAIN RUN (three filings by one filer in one cycle, all inside this PDF): report 1 (Mar 13 - Jun 15) ends cumulative expenses 571.00; report 3 (Jun 16 - Oct 27) opens LAST 571.00, THIS 0, CUM 571.00; report 2 (Oct 27 - Dec 31) opens LAST 571.00, THIS 0, CUM 571.00. The chain closes, and it proves the BUNDLE IS OUT OF CHRONOLOGICAL ORDER: pages 4-6 are the LAST report of the cycle and pages 7-9 the middle one. Report 3's period start (June 16) is exactly report 1's period end + 1 day, and report 2's corrected start (October 27) is report 3's period end - contiguous. FILER ARITHMETIC on line 4: report 1 prints the ending balance as a POSITIVE '571.' in both the THIS and CUMULATIVE cells, but 0 contributions - 571.00 expenses = NEGATIVE 571.00; reports 3 and 2 both print it correctly as '<571.00>' in angle brackets (this filer's negative notation, the same convention his 2006 filing used). Report 1's sign error is the FILER's and is retained verbatim - not corrected.

notes: BUNDLE of 3 reports - agrees with the chunk file's n_reports=3. OUT OF CHRONOLOGICAL ORDER (see balance_chain): p1-3 = Mar/Jun, p7-9 = Jun/Oct, p4-6 = Oct/Dec. OFFICE NOT DOCUMENT-VERIFIABLE, flagged: the 'Office' line is BLANK on all three covers, and the filer instead wrote 'WASHINGTON COUNTY' (report 1) / 'WASHINGTON' (reports 2-3) on the 'In the ____ School District' line. Because the school-district line is the only body named on the form, I checked scope against a primary source rather than the label: the county's own 2020 general-election canvass (washington_county/elections/raw/2020/11/washco-election-20201103-results-export.csv) carries 'REP DAVID WHITEHEAD' as the candidate for the contest 'County Treasurer'. This is a COUNTY TREASURER filing, in scope; the module's index (office_source=portal_listing, office_confidence=medium) is corroborated, and the School-District line is a mis-filled field, NOT evidence of a school-board filing. A human may want that noted against the existing filing_totals caveat, which already records the blank Office line. DATE ODDITIES worth a human eye: report 2 is signed 12-31-2020 but clerk-stamped RECEIVED DEC 15 2020 (stamp PRECEDES the signature date by 16 days), and its period start 'December 15' was struck out and rewritten as 'OCTOBER 27, 2020'; report 3 is signed and stamped 10/21/2020 for a period certified as ending 10/27/2020 (period end AFTER the signature) - the same pattern seen on d2a6f2de, so it looks like these filers write the statutory deadline as the period end. All dates transcribed from the form; none adjusted. PRIVACY: every cover prints the candidate's home street address, city, ZIP and two phone numbers in the clear - all discarded. The single expenditure row's payee is the county Clerk/Auditor (a filing fee), no personal data. PDF stores Page rot 270; pct: geometry is in the portrait frame poppler renders.
